about: Everyone who has been above 80 km, and each leg of their flights: who was where, when. From Jonathan McDowell's human spaceflight lists (astro.tsv, segments.tsv, suborb.html for the short flights' heights), written by scripts/spaceflight/build_crews.py. Who was in space at time t is every leg with from_s <= t < to_s; 'on' is the pack log for the craft or station, null where the pack has none (suborbital hops).
credit: Jonathan C. McDowell, Jonathan's Space Report human spaceflight lists, planet4589.org, CC BY 4.0
